stories.title: Latest intel on NFL Week 5: What we're hearing on key injuries, potential trades, early coaching buzz
stories.summary: Could injuries to Saquon Barkley, Lamar Jackson and others derail their teams? Which AFC teams should trade for a WR? Which coordinators could get head coach interest?

stories.title: Jaguars to play 26 of next 30 regular-season games away from Jacksonville
stories.summary: The Jaguars will become the first NFL team since 1926 to play in 12 or more stadiums in a single season.

stories.title: 'Beast' King steps up in relief to help Padres stay alive in NLDS
stories.summary: Game 1 starter Michael King lived up to his declaration, coming in to pitch the final two innings as the Padres avoided playoff elimination with a 4-3 victory over the Brewers in Game 3 of the NLDS.

stories.title: Gauff falls to Mertens, says abusive comments were 'draining'
stories.summary: Coco Gauff lost to Elise Mertens, whom she had beaten in all five of their previous matchups, before saying she felt drained over the abusive comments she received during the China Open.

stories.title: Report: Cora again declines chance to manage Phils, plans to take '27 off
stories.summary: Alex Cora once again has declined the opportunity to manage the Phillies, informing the club that he plans to take the 2027 season off, according to USA Today Sports.
